The former Tropical Storm “Bualoi,” which has now dissipated, brought heavy rainfall from 28 September 2025, causing flash floods and landslides in 18 provinces. A total of 13,874 households or 49,689 people were affected. Three deaths were reported, and five people remain missing in Uttaradit.

Flooding continues in eight provinces—Phitsanulok, Phetchabun, Uttaradit, Loei, Nong Bua Lamphu, Khon Kaen, Surin, and Nakhon Ratchasima—affecting 8,622 households or 31,898 people.

Rainfall is expected to decrease over the next 24 hours, though heavy rain may persist in western parts of the north and central regions, particularly Mae Hong Son, Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, and Tak. Residents should beware of flash floods, runoff, and riverbank overflow, especially in foothills and low-lying areas.

Waves in the upper Andaman Sea are 1–2 meters high, rising above 2 meters in stormy areas. Mariners are advised to exercise caution.

A tropical depression east of the Philippines is expected to strengthen into a tropical storm and move into the upper South China Sea on 3–4 October, making landfall in northern Vietnam on 5–6 October.

Bangkok and surrounding areas can expect thunderstorms in 40% of the area, with temperatures of 25–34°C and southwesterly winds at 10–20 km/hr.

Photos from Chiang Mai's Fang District this morning.

#Thailand #น้ำท่วม #น้ำท่วม68 #น้ำท่วม2568

Circle of Trust

A friend of mine told me something two years ago, it redefined for me what true friendship is forever.

This friend of mine suddenly found himself in the midst of a storm. His wife, a very insecure and combative woman, suddenly decided he would have to make a choice between being a pastor and being married.
She said she was not comfortable being married to a pastor anymore, and this friend of mine didn't know how to do anything else but pastor a church.
,,
He tried appealing to the wife, made a lot of concessions, but the wife said, "If I leave you, it will ruin your ministry. Nobody will attend a church pastored by a divorcee! So I have this power over you, and I will use it because I can't stand you ministering to people when your job is to stay at home and cater to me and the children.”

This friend has tried this “leave the ministry and get a job approach for over ten years at the instruction of his wife, and those ten years were the most miserable years of his life
He was a campus fellowship leader, and he had always known the only path for him in life was to fulfill the call of God upon his destiny.
Somehow, after ten years doing odd jobs, he found his way back into ministry, and it was unto him the bread of life
The more he succeeded, the more his wife lost her mind, until one day, his wife hit him with something on the head, and he lost consciousness for almost twelve hours.
After that incident, he decided his life was in danger and he would have to agree to his wife’s demand or end up in the grave
However, he had a lot of invitations to minister which he had to honour, while considering his wife’s demand, he spoke to his wife and her mother and had a discussion with them about his commitments till the month of October 2023.

He promised he wouldn’t accept any invitations apart from the ones already accepted, and by October, he would have an answer for her regarding the future of the marriage
All he wanted was for them to care for the children in unity.
The wife’s mother spoke to her daughter, and an agreement was reached.
He was to leave pastoring in October that year or lose his marriage
This agreement was reached in January, so he still had ten months
This brother called a few believers and shared with them his dilemma
He wanted them to pray along with him for a change of heart for his wife before the deadline, and he also wanted God to speak on the issue decisively
His team went into prayer and fasting
He continued to minister, and things got interesting.
The door of nations was suddenly opened to him with invitations from Canada, the United Kingdom, Ghana, the Philippines, and the USA, all flooding in
The evidence of the anointing of the Holy Spirit on his life also increased exponentially
He got home and shared the news of the letters of invitation and other open doors with his wife
His wife went berserk, claiming he wanted to turn her into a slave who would be taking care of the children while he gallivanted all over the world
By now, they were in the month of February, and he still had eight months
He decided to take up the opportunity to minister in some of those countries while he still had time
He travelled to Ghana, and from there he proceeded to the United Kingdom
It was while he was in the United Kingdom in the month of February that he got a court notice of separation and divorce from his wife by mail
He had to cut his journey short and rush back to Nigeria to keep up with the court date fixed for the hearing on how to access his children, whom his wife had left the marriage with.
He had no lawyer; he was not prepared for war, but war had found its way to his doorstep
He reached out to his friends and told them what had happened. Some of them were stirred immediately to support him in every way they could
They got him lawyers, helped him secure his house, which his wife had vandalized (removed gadgets and other things from the house as she left), and so on.
He found himself in an uncharted territory of life, and he needed help on how to navigate the dangerous twists and turns
He got a lawyer, went to court, and the judge made an interesting ruling
The judge reversed the wife’s demand for sole custody to joint custody and told the pastor that, since he had a five-year-old daughter, he would have to get a mature female into his house before she would allow his daughter to visit him because of possible sexual molestation
The judge advised that he get his mother, a female relative, a domestic staff, or a wife as soon as possible if he ever hope to get to spend time with his daughter
(His wife had written to the court as part of her allegations against him that he and his daughter shared an uncommon bond because the daughter always wanted to sleep beside her father whenever he was at home instead of the children’s room or by her side)

This friend of mine reached out to his friends once again and explained what the judge said in detail.
One offered to marry him, but he turned her down immediately, and their friendship didn’t survive it
One offered to provide him with a domestic staff, but being a single man, he felt it was inappropriate to live in the same house alone with a woman, so that option didn’t work
His mother was abroad doing omugwo (Nigerian mothers would often do this to help their daughters when they have a baby)
He was stuck
After some long and hard reflections, he decided it would be best to remarry as soon as possible
He needed a wife, and he also needed to have access to his daughter.

He looked at all the accomplished single ladies around him and decided to ask one of them out.
The one he asked out agreed.
He told her the relationship cannot become public yet because he just got divorced, but he needed her to make herself available for him on some weekends so that he could write to the court and inform the judge that he now has an adult female who would help with his daughter
The lady agreed
He picked a weekend, wrote to the judge and his separated wife informing them of the development
The lady he picked felt he really didn’t love her, but only approached her to be his girlfriend, just to get access to his daughter
He reached out to one of his friends and told her what was going on while asking her to please speak to the lady in question and assure her of his love and commitment to the relationship, while he navigates the curves life has thrown at him
This friend assured him that she would help him sort it out because the other lady was a close friend of hers

It was a mistake.
The next day, his girlfriend called him and said, “You cannot believe what I am hearing.”
He said, “What are you hearing?”
His girlfriend picked up her phone and called the friend he spoke with the previous day.
She then proceeded to put the call on speaker
The friend he spoke to was unaware that he was on the call, and she proceeded to say the most damning things about him to his girlfriend
“Why would you date someone who has been traumatized and damaged by a toxic wife? I am not saying you can’t marry him, but you must make him go through therapy. His wife may be flawed, but she cannot be the devil. He must suddenly have some serious issues that his wife cannot cope with, or do you think a woman would suddenly abandon her marriage without a good reason? He is likely to have no boundaries, and he might be cheating on his wife. I am just asking you to look before you leap because marriage is a serious issue. What if he is only using you to gain access to the children? It is too soon for him to be in another relationship. He should sort out his divorce first, and you must ensure that you do investigations to find out anything he is hiding from you.”
He didn’t see anything wrong with the phone call; he felt the friend was only doing what he asked her to do, and if it involved saying some things about him that were not flattering, but necessary, so be it.

A few minutes later, he got a call from another friend. The friend told him she had been duly informed that he was seeing someone, and the person who called her said a lot of things that were of great concern to her.
He asked his friend what the issues were, and the friend began to talk about his girlfriend.
“Why do you want to date this lady? She was abandoned by her father when she was young, and that was why she has not been able to settle down till now. She has serious psychological issues and has been with several married men as a side chick. She frequents clubs, including strip clubs, and is not likely to be faithful. She is the worst fit for a pastor, and I believe you are rushing into this decision without seeking the face of God, simply because you wanted to have access to your daughter. Do you know how many abortions she has had? Do you know how many men had flown her abroad for escort duties? Why do you think she travels abroad covertly and only shares pictures of the wings of a plane or of herself at a foreign airport? Which lady in this world who was not born to wealth will just wake up and start flying all over the world while living in a one-bedroom apartment in an obscure area of Lagos? You men have eyes but cannot see.
Did this lady tell you everything about her past, or is she hiding anything? I am speaking to you as a friend who has a lot of concern for you.
This lady is not the angel she claims to be

Unfortunately or fortunately, his phone was on speakerphone, and his girlfriend overheard the conversation.

Unlike him, who took what he heard maturely, his girlfriend cried her eyes out.

“These are people I call my friends, people I confide in, people I love and fellowship with, see all the things they have said about me simply because they didn’t want you to marry me. I cannot believe the betrayal, the backstabbing, and the malicious things I am hearing about myself from your friend. How did she know we are dating? Who fed her information about me?”

That was the question.

This friend told only one person, the person, out of concern, called another person, and that person then called another person.

Phone calls began to fly in from all over to both of them

All the phone calls were from ladies who were in their circle of trust, and all the phone calls were brutal and decapitating.

He heard himself spoken of and described in ways that were not only untrue but malicious, and so did she.

The relationship ended.
The circle of trust was also broken irretrievably.

PS: Why wouldn’t you just look a friend in the eye and say, “This is a bad idea?” If you think he or she is making a mistake?
He said he asked the lady he spoke to that question, and she said, “I was concerned about you and felt I should talk to another friend of ours, who I believe is closer to you.”
How then did it become a national debate?
Someone heard it and felt it was a good gossip topic, so she picked up her phone and called another person, and it went on and on and on
It is friends we do not value that we treat that way
It is not only condescending and judgmental, but it also diminishes and denigrates the friend whom you have treated that way
If he or she is a friend or considers you a friend, try treating the friendship with value by being candid with each other.
True friendship demands it

-GSW-

Phone calls began to fly in from all over to both of them All the phone calls were from ladies who were in their circle of trust, and all the phone calls were brutal and decapitating. He heard himself spoken of and described in ways that were not only untrue but malicious, and so did she. The relationship ended. The circle of trust was also broken irretrievably. PS: Why wouldn’t you just look a friend in the eye and say, “This is a bad idea?” If you think he or she is making a mistake? He said he asked the lady he spoke to that question, and she said, “I was concerned about you and felt I should talk to another friend of ours, who I believe is closer to you.” How then did it become a national debate? Someone heard it and felt it was a good gossip topic, so she picked up her phone and called another person, and it went on and on and on It is friends we do not value that we treat that way It is not only condescending and judgmental, but it also diminishes and denigrates the friend whom you have treated that way If he or she is a friend or considers you a friend, try treating the friendship with value by being candid with each other. True friendship demands it -GSW-
data.english_translation: Circle of Trust A friend of mine told me something two years ago, it redefined for me what true friendship is forever. This friend of mine suddenly found himself in the midst of a storm. His wife, a very insecure and combative woman, suddenly decided he would have to make a choice between being a pastor and being married. She said she was not comfortable being married to a pastor anymore, and this friend of mine didn't know how to do anything else but pastor a church. ,, He tried appealing to the wife, made a lot of concessions, but the wife said, "If I leave you, it will ruin your ministry. Nobody will attend a church pastored by a divorcee! So I have this power over you, and I will use it because I can't stand you ministering to people when your job is to stay at home and cater to me and the children.” This friend has tried this “leave the ministry and get a job approach for over ten years at the instruction of his wife, and those ten years were the most miserable years of his life He was a campus fellowship leader, and he had always known the only path for him in life was to fulfill the call of God upon his destiny. Somehow, after ten years doing odd jobs, he found his way back into ministry, and it was unto him the bread of life The more he succeeded, the more his wife lost her mind, until one day, his wife hit him with something on the head, and he lost consciousness for almost twelve hours. After that incident, he decided his life was in danger and he would have to agree to his wife’s demand or end up in the grave However, he had a lot of invitations to minister which he had to honour, while considering his wife’s demand, he spoke to his wife and her mother and had a discussion with them about his commitments till the month of October 2023. He promised he wouldn’t accept any invitations apart from the ones already accepted, and by October, he would have an answer for her regarding the future of the marriage All he wanted was for them to care for the children in unity. The wife’s mother spoke to her daughter, and an agreement was reached. He was to leave pastoring in October that year or lose his marriage This agreement was reached in January, so he still had ten months This brother called a few believers and shared with them his dilemma He wanted them to pray along with him for a change of heart for his wife before the deadline, and he also wanted God to speak on the issue decisively His team went into prayer and fasting He continued to minister, and things got interesting. The door of nations was suddenly opened to him with invitations from Canada, the United Kingdom, Ghana, the Philippines, and the USA, all flooding in The evidence of the anointing of the Holy Spirit on his life also increased exponentially He got home and shared the news of the letters of invitation and other open doors with his wife His wife went berserk, claiming he wanted to turn her into a slave who would be taking care of the children while he gallivanted all over the world By now, they were in the month of February, and he still had eight months He decided to take up the opportunity to minister in some of those countries while he still had time He travelled to Ghana, and from there he proceeded to the United Kingdom It was while he was in the United Kingdom in the month of February that he got a court notice of separation and divorce from his wife by mail He had to cut his journey short and rush back to Nigeria to keep up with the court date fixed for the hearing on how to access his children, whom his wife had left the marriage with. He had no lawyer; he was not prepared for war, but war had found its way to his doorstep He reached out to his friends and told them what had happened. Some of them were stirred immediately to support him in every way they could They got him lawyers, helped him secure his house, which his wife had vandalized (removed gadgets and other things from the house as she left), and so on. He found himself in an uncharted territory of life, and he needed help on how to navigate the dangerous twists and turns He got a lawyer, went to court, and the judge made an interesting ruling The judge reversed the wife’s demand for sole custody to joint custody and told the pastor that, since he had a five-year-old daughter, he would have to get a mature female into his house before she would allow his daughter to visit him because of possible sexual molestation The judge advised that he get his mother, a female relative, a domestic staff, or a wife as soon as possible if he ever hope to get to spend time with his daughter (His wife had written to the court as part of her allegations against him that he and his daughter shared an uncommon bond because the daughter always wanted to sleep beside her father whenever he was at home instead of the children’s room or by her side) This friend of mine reached out to his friends once again and explained what the judge said in detail. One offered to marry him, but he turned her down immediately, and their friendship didn’t survive it One offered to provide him with a domestic staff, but being a single man, he felt it was inappropriate to live in the same house alone with a woman, so that option didn’t work His mother was abroad doing omugwo (Nigerian mothers would often do this to help their daughters when they have a baby) He was stuck After some long and hard reflections, he decided it would be best to remarry as soon as possible He needed a wife, and he also needed to have access to his daughter. He looked at all the accomplished single ladies around him and decided to ask one of them out. The one he asked out agreed. He told her the relationship cannot become public yet because he just got divorced, but he needed her to make herself available for him on some weekends so that he could write to the court and inform the judge that he now has an adult female who would help with his daughter The lady agreed He picked a weekend, wrote to the judge and his separated wife informing them of the development The lady he picked felt he really didn’t love her, but only approached her to be his girlfriend, just to get access to his daughter He reached out to one of his friends and told her what was going on while asking her to please speak to the lady in question and assure her of his love and commitment to the relationship, while he navigates the curves life has thrown at him This friend assured him that she would help him sort it out because the other lady was a close friend of hers It was a mistake. The next day, his girlfriend called him and said, “You cannot believe what I am hearing.” He said, “What are you hearing?” His girlfriend picked up her phone and called the friend he spoke with the previous day. She then proceeded to put the call on speaker The friend he spoke to was unaware that he was on the call, and she proceeded to say the most damning things about him to his girlfriend “Why would you date someone who has been traumatized and damaged by a toxic wife? I am not saying you can’t marry him, but you must make him go through therapy. His wife may be flawed, but she cannot be the devil. He must suddenly have some serious issues that his wife cannot cope with, or do you think a woman would suddenly abandon her marriage without a good reason? He is likely to have no boundaries, and he might be cheating on his wife. I am just asking you to look before you leap because marriage is a serious issue. What if he is only using you to gain access to the children? It is too soon for him to be in another relationship. He should sort out his divorce first, and you must ensure that you do investigations to find out anything he is hiding from you.” He didn’t see anything wrong with the phone call; he felt the friend was only doing what he asked her to do, and if it involved saying some things about him that were not flattering, but necessary, so be it. A few minutes later, he got a call from another friend. The friend told him she had been duly informed that he was seeing someone, and the person who called her said a lot of things that were of great concern to her. He asked his friend what the issues were, and the friend began to talk about his girlfriend. “Why do you want to date this lady? She was abandoned by her father when she was young, and that was why she has not been able to settle down till now. She has serious psychological issues and has been with several married men as a side chick. She frequents clubs, including strip clubs, and is not likely to be faithful. She is the worst fit for a pastor, and I believe you are rushing into this decision without seeking the face of God, simply because you wanted to have access to your daughter. Do you know how many abortions she has had? Do you know how many men had flown her abroad for escort duties? Why do you think she travels abroad covertly and only shares pictures of the wings of a plane or of herself at a foreign airport? Which lady in this world who was not born to wealth will just wake up and start flying all over the world while living in a one-bedroom apartment in an obscure area of Lagos? You men have eyes but cannot see. Did this lady tell you everything about her past, or is she hiding anything? I am speaking to you as a friend who has a lot of concern for you. This lady is not the angel she claims to be Unfortunately or fortunately, his phone was on speakerphone, and his girlfriend overheard the conversation. Unlike him, who took what he heard maturely, his girlfriend cried her eyes out. “These are people I call my friends, people I confide in, people I love and fellowship with, see all the things they have said about me simply because they didn’t want you to marry me. I cannot believe the betrayal, the backstabbing, and the malicious things I am hearing about myself from your friend. How did she know we are dating? 🚨🇵🇭PHILIPPINES QUAKE DEATH TOLL RISES TO 72

The death toll from the 6.9-magnitude earthquake that struck off Cebu, Philippines, has climbed to 72, with 294 injured, officials said Thursday. 

🔹The shallow quake damaged power lines, bridges, and historic buildings, including a century-old church. 

🔹It is the country’s deadliest quake since 2013, when a 7.2 tremor in Bohol killed 222 people. The Philippines, located on the Pacific “Ring of Fire,” endures more than 800 earthquakes annually.

-Reuters
